en.tagline: Turns text into video with AI voices
en.description: Fliki makes videos from text. You type a script or paste a link to a blog. Fliki picks footage and reads the text aloud with an AI voice. There are voices in many languages, including Dutch.
bestFor: Videos with a voice-over without your own voice
